    基础滤波算法模拟¶

    验证移动平均、低通、高通、高斯、中值滤波的效果

    In [1]:
    Copied! 
    import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from utils import *
    import numpy as np import matplotlib.pyplot as plt import sys sys.path.insert(0, '.') from utils import *

    1. 移动平均滤波¶

    In [2]:
    Copied! 
    # 生成测试信号
t, x_true, x_noisy = generate_noisy_signal(signal_type='sine', n_samples=200, noise_std=0.3, seed=42)

# 不同窗口大小的移动平均
window_sizes = [3, 5, 10, 20]
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 5))

plt.plot(t, x_true, 'b-', linewidth=2, label='True')
plt.plot(t, x_noisy, 'gray', alpha=0.5, linewidth=1, label='Noisy')

for ws in window_sizes:
    x_filtered = moving_average_filter(x_noisy, ws)
    plt.plot(t, x_filtered, '--', linewidth=1.5, label=f'N={ws}')

plt.xlabel('Time (s)')
plt.ylabel('Amplitude')
plt.title('Moving Average Filter - Different Window Sizes')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.show()

# 计算不同窗口的均方根误差 (RMSE)
print("Moving Average Filter RMSE:")
for ws in window_sizes:
    x_filtered = moving_average_filter(x_noisy, ws)
    rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((x_filtered - x_true) ** 2))
    print(f"  Window={ws:2d}: RMSE = {rmse:.4f}")
    # 生成测试信号 t, x_true, x_noisy = generate_noisy_signal(signal_type='sine', n_samples=200, noise_std=0.3, seed=42) # 不同窗口大小的移动平均 window_sizes = [3, 5, 10, 20] plt.figure(figsize=(14, 5)) plt.plot(t, x_true, 'b-', linewidth=2, label='True') plt.plot(t, x_noisy, 'gray', alpha=0.5, linewidth=1, label='Noisy') for ws in window_sizes: x_filtered = moving_average_filter(x_noisy, ws) plt.plot(t, x_filtered, '--', linewidth=1.5, label=f'N={ws}') plt.xlabel('Time (s)') plt.ylabel('Amplitude') plt.title('Moving Average Filter - Different Window Sizes') plt.legend() plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3) plt.show() # 计算不同窗口的均方根误差 (RMSE) print("Moving Average Filter RMSE:") for ws in window_sizes: x_filtered = moving_average_filter(x_noisy, ws) rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((x_filtered - x_true) ** 2)) print(f" Window={ws:2d}: RMSE = {rmse:.4f}")
    Moving Average Filter RMSE:
  Window= 3: RMSE = 0.2538
  Window= 5: RMSE = 0.3847
  Window=10: RMSE = 0.6049
  Window=20: RMSE = 0.8308

    2. 低通滤波¶

    In [3]:
    Copied! 
    # 不同平滑系数的低通滤波
alphas = [0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5]
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 5))

plt.plot(t, x_true, 'b-', linewidth=2, label='True')
plt.plot(t, x_noisy, 'gray', alpha=0.5, linewidth=1, label='Noisy')

for alpha in alphas:
    x_filtered = low_pass_filter(x_noisy, alpha)
    plt.plot(t, x_filtered, '--', linewidth=1.5, label=f'alpha={alpha}')

plt.xlabel('Time (s)')
plt.ylabel('Amplitude')
plt.title('Low-Pass Filter - Different Smoothing Factors')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.show()

# RMSE 分析
print("Low-Pass Filter RMSE:")
for alpha in alphas:
    x_filtered = low_pass_filter(x_noisy, alpha)
    rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((x_filtered - x_true) ** 2))
    print(f"  alpha={alpha:.2f}: RMSE = {rmse:.4f}")
    # 不同平滑系数的低通滤波 alphas = [0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5] plt.figure(figsize=(14, 5)) plt.plot(t, x_true, 'b-', linewidth=2, label='True') plt.plot(t, x_noisy, 'gray', alpha=0.5, linewidth=1, label='Noisy') for alpha in alphas: x_filtered = low_pass_filter(x_noisy, alpha) plt.plot(t, x_filtered, '--', linewidth=1.5, label=f'alpha={alpha}') plt.xlabel('Time (s)') plt.ylabel('Amplitude') plt.title('Low-Pass Filter - Different Smoothing Factors') plt.legend() plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3) plt.show() # RMSE 分析 print("Low-Pass Filter RMSE:") for alpha in alphas: x_filtered = low_pass_filter(x_noisy, alpha) rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((x_filtered - x_true) ** 2)) print(f" alpha={alpha:.2f}: RMSE = {rmse:.4f}")

    3. 高通滤波¶

    In [4]:
    Copied! 
    # 生成带有直流偏置的测试信号
t, x_true, x_noisy = generate_noisy_signal(signal_type='sine', n_samples=200, noise_std=0.2, seed=42)
x_noisy_with_bias = x_noisy + 2.0  # 添加直流偏置
x_true_with_bias = x_true + 2.0

# 高通滤波去除偏置
alphas = [0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3]
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 5))

plt.plot(t, x_true_with_bias - 2, 'b-', linewidth=2, label='Original (debiased)')
plt.plot(t, x_noisy_with_bias, 'gray', alpha=0.5, linewidth=1, label='Noisy with bias')

for alpha in alphas:
    x_filtered = high_pass_filter(x_noisy_with_bias, alpha)
    plt.plot(t, x_filtered, '--', linewidth=1.5, label=f'alpha={alpha}')

plt.xlabel('Time (s)')
plt.ylabel('Amplitude')
plt.title('High-Pass Filter - Remove DC Bias')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.show()
    # 生成带有直流偏置的测试信号 t, x_true, x_noisy = generate_noisy_signal(signal_type='sine', n_samples=200, noise_std=0.2, seed=42) x_noisy_with_bias = x_noisy + 2.0 # 添加直流偏置 x_true_with_bias = x_true + 2.0 # 高通滤波去除偏置 alphas = [0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3] plt.figure(figsize=(14, 5)) plt.plot(t, x_true_with_bias - 2, 'b-', linewidth=2, label='Original (debiased)') plt.plot(t, x_noisy_with_bias, 'gray', alpha=0.5, linewidth=1, label='Noisy with bias') for alpha in alphas: x_filtered = high_pass_filter(x_noisy_with_bias, alpha) plt.plot(t, x_filtered, '--', linewidth=1.5, label=f'alpha={alpha}') plt.xlabel('Time (s)') plt.ylabel('Amplitude') plt.title('High-Pass Filter - Remove DC Bias') plt.legend() plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3) plt.show()

    5. 中值滤波¶

    In [6]:
    Copied! 
    # 生成带脉冲噪声的信号
n_samples = 200
x_with_impulse = generate_impulse_noise(n_samples=n_samples, noise_prob=0.1, noise_magnitude=3, seed=42)
x_clean = np.sin(np.linspace(0, 4 * np.pi, n_samples))
t = np.linspace(0, 10, n_samples)

# 不同窗口的中值滤波
window_sizes = [3, 5, 7, 9]
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 5))

plt.plot(t, x_clean, 'b-', linewidth=2, label='Clean')
plt.plot(t, x_with_impulse, 'gray', alpha=0.5, linewidth=1, label='Impulse noise')

for ws in window_sizes:
    x_filtered = median_filter(x_with_impulse, ws)
    plt.plot(t, x_filtered, '--', linewidth=1.5, label=f'N={ws}')

plt.xlabel('Time (s)')
plt.ylabel('Amplitude')
plt.title('Median Filter - Remove Impulse Noise')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.show()

# RMSE 分析
print("Median Filter RMSE:")
for ws in window_sizes:
    x_filtered = median_filter(x_with_impulse, ws)
    rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((x_filtered - x_clean) ** 2))
    print(f"  Window={ws}: RMSE = {rmse:.4f}")
    # 生成带脉冲噪声的信号 n_samples = 200 x_with_impulse = generate_impulse_noise(n_samples=n_samples, noise_prob=0.1, noise_magnitude=3, seed=42) x_clean = np.sin(np.linspace(0, 4 * np.pi, n_samples)) t = np.linspace(0, 10, n_samples) # 不同窗口的中值滤波 window_sizes = [3, 5, 7, 9] plt.figure(figsize=(14, 5)) plt.plot(t, x_clean, 'b-', linewidth=2, label='Clean') plt.plot(t, x_with_impulse, 'gray', alpha=0.5, linewidth=1, label='Impulse noise') for ws in window_sizes: x_filtered = median_filter(x_with_impulse, ws) plt.plot(t, x_filtered, '--', linewidth=1.5, label=f'N={ws}') plt.xlabel('Time (s)') plt.ylabel('Amplitude') plt.title('Median Filter - Remove Impulse Noise') plt.legend() plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3) plt.show() # RMSE 分析 print("Median Filter RMSE:") for ws in window_sizes: x_filtered = median_filter(x_with_impulse, ws) rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((x_filtered - x_clean) ** 2)) print(f" Window={ws}: RMSE = {rmse:.4f}")

    6. 滤波器对比¶

    In [7]:
    Copied! 
    # 统一测试条件：同一噪声信号，不同滤波器
t, x_true, x_noisy = generate_noisy_signal(signal_type='mixed', n_samples=200, noise_std=0.3, seed=123)

filters = {
    'Moving Avg (N=5)': moving_average_filter(x_noisy, 5),
    'Low-Pass (a=0.1)': low_pass_filter(x_noisy, 0.1),
    'Gaussian (s=1.5)': gaussian_filter_1d(x_noisy, 1.5),
}

plt.figure(figsize=(14, 6))

plt.subplot(2, 1, 1)
plt.plot(t, x_true, 'b-', linewidth=2, label='True')
plt.plot(t, x_noisy, 'gray', alpha=0.5, linewidth=1, label='Noisy')
for name, filtered in filters.items():
    plt.plot(t, filtered, '--', linewidth=1.5, label=name)
plt.ylabel('Amplitude')
plt.title('Filter Comparison')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.subplot(2, 1, 2)
plt.plot(t, x_true - x_noisy, 'gray', alpha=0.5, linewidth=1, label='Noise')
for name, filtered in filters.items():
    error = filtered - x_true
    plt.plot(t, error, '--', linewidth=1.5, label=f'{name} Error')
plt.xlabel('Time (s)')
plt.ylabel('Error')
plt.title('Filter Error')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 综合 RMSE 对比
print("\nFilter RMSE Comparison:")
for name, filtered in filters.items():
    rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((filtered - x_true) ** 2))
    print(f"  {name}: {rmse:.4f}")
    # 统一测试条件：同一噪声信号，不同滤波器 t, x_true, x_noisy = generate_noisy_signal(signal_type='mixed', n_samples=200, noise_std=0.3, seed=123) filters = { 'Moving Avg (N=5)': moving_average_filter(x_noisy, 5), 'Low-Pass (a=0.1)': low_pass_filter(x_noisy, 0.1), 'Gaussian (s=1.5)': gaussian_filter_1d(x_noisy, 1.5), } plt.figure(figsize=(14, 6)) plt.subplot(2, 1, 1) plt.plot(t, x_true, 'b-', linewidth=2, label='True') plt.plot(t, x_noisy, 'gray', alpha=0.5, linewidth=1, label='Noisy') for name, filtered in filters.items(): plt.plot(t, filtered, '--', linewidth=1.5, label=name) plt.ylabel('Amplitude') plt.title('Filter Comparison') plt.legend() plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3) plt.subplot(2, 1, 2) plt.plot(t, x_true - x_noisy, 'gray', alpha=0.5, linewidth=1, label='Noise') for name, filtered in filters.items(): error = filtered - x_true plt.plot(t, error, '--', linewidth=1.5, label=f'{name} Error') plt.xlabel('Time (s)') plt.ylabel('Error') plt.title('Filter Error') plt.legend() plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3) plt.tight_layout() plt.show() # 综合 RMSE 对比 print("\nFilter RMSE Comparison:") for name, filtered in filters.items(): rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((filtered - x_true) ** 2)) print(f" {name}: {rmse:.4f}")
    Filter RMSE Comparison:
  Moving Avg (N=5): 0.4946
  Low-Pass (a=0.1): 0.6892
  Gaussian (s=1.5): 0.2015

    7. 分析与结论¶

    观测结果¶

    1. 移动平均：窗口越大，平滑效果越强，但信号延迟也越大。适合简单场景。

    2. 低通滤波：α 越小截止频率越低。α=0.1~0.2 是较好的平衡点。

    3. 高通滤波：有效去除直流偏置，但会放大高频噪声。

    4. 高斯滤波：比移动平均更好地保留信号形状，但计算量稍大。σ=1.0~2.0 效果较好。

    5. 中值滤波：对脉冲噪声效果显著，但对规则噪声效果一般。

    局限性与适用场景¶

    • 这些基础滤波器无法自适应调整参数
    • 当噪声与信号频率重叠时，滤波效果有限
    • 对于复杂动态系统，需要卡尔曼滤波等自适应方法
